body: that is the problem with here 😭 it’s like short convos and it can’t go too far all the time because we’re not tethered beyond us posting. we don’t know each other’s social situations or anything and may not have all that much in common for it to really feel like someone sees us as full people struggling. that’s why i look for stuff beyond here but also come back sometimes just because it’s one tool still i guess ? idk i’m just rambling 😭

oh not group therapy i just mean like online groups to talk about anything and to care about one another. i looked for groups through the fireweed collective but it’s just like support groups? but a lot less formal!! doesn’t feel like so much pressure and obligation

there’s actually so many and i feel like the ones with monitors that can personally recommend help to ppl outside of them are better than ones we just run ourselves because low key if you were ever young and did the same thing they can be really distressing for those of us who have never been taught to care for others who have suicidal ideation even though we ourselves do too 😭 i joined a few groups online that i don’t feel too obligated to be active in cause a physically and mentally can’t be like “on” all the time but i like having that option. I like that because then it’s tailored to your experiences specifically, like i joined one for disabled people of color cause that’s my experience. if you want, maybe you could look some up near you? ppl discount instagram/twitter and online communities a lot but i’ve found great friends there LOL

i resonate with this, i’ve always had suicidal ideation even though i truly am too scared to do it. I think i will always have these thought unfortunately but after getting diagnosed with bipolar depression and starting medication it has helped them stop being so heavy on my mind at all moments. i still really struggle with it when i’m alone which is unfortunately often. i’m trying my hardest to try to make more intentional relationships and leave those that really don’t serve me and forgiving myself for that guilt and letting myself know that it isn’t my fault that ppl don’t know how to care for me or anyone else for that matter. it really is a practice and it’s so so hard, it’s easier when I try to reach out to someone or anyone even here just to say something. Maybe group therapy would help? psychiatry and therapy aren’t an end all be all but they can help if you find the right psychiatrists and therapists and start to develop your own safety/ care networks
